policyReview.summary: Rechecked the official AdSense Program Policies (last updated August 4, 2026), Google Publisher Policies, Google Search Essentials, helpful-content guidance, and consent requirements on 2026-11-24. Confirmed restrictions on copyright infringement, misrepresentation, deceptive navigation, and ads on non-content pages. Google's Search guidance warns against scaled content made mainly for rankings, including automated or AI-produced pages that add little value; it explicitly states there is no preferred word count. A Google-certified CMP integrated with IAB TCF is required for personalized ads to users in the EEA, UK, and Switzerland. This is a compliance review, not an AdSense approval prediction.
